secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key (Supabase Dashboard -> Project Settings -> API keys). Required for the /app beta to read/write the database; without it /app returns 500 while the static landing page still works.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password that guards the /admin page. Pick anything strong. Optional for the landing page and beta app.
